title: Trees knocked flat to the northeast

tellings.quote: and Bill said, "You know, if they drag that thing up to the dragon wagon, they use [music] soft trees to do it over. These aren't going to hurt anything." And he said, "Notice they're all spled to the northeast."

plain: At Hart Canyon near Aztec, New Mexico, where a craft is said to have crashed in 1948, the trees were knocked flat and all lie pointing northeast. Scott Ramsey, a researcher of the Aztec case, tells Michels what Bill Steinman, an earlier investigator, told him at the site: the recovery team would have dragged the craft up to a "dragon wagon", a heavy military haul vehicle, over soft trees that would not damage it, and the trees all splay to the northeast. On this account, the fallen trees would be a mark left on the ground by the recovery.
